pilotMode.title: [EN] Pilot mode
pilotMode.body: [EN] No payment, hiring decision, or verification happens automatically here. Real activation requires owner or admin review.

tier2Readiness.title: [EN] What Tier-2 (manual activation) will eventually require
tier2Readiness.body: [EN] Tier-2 is the manual-activation tier for organisations that want a serious pilot. This card is a preview of what an owner or admin will ask for when you request a pilot review. Nothing on this page is submitted to the Tier-2 schema today, and Tier-2 status stays 'pilot' until owner / admin review completes.
tier2Readiness.requirementsTitle: [EN] Information the manual review will ask for
requirements: [EN] Organisation legal name and country of registration.
[EN] Correspondence address: country, city, street line, postcode.
[EN] One named human representative with their role (director, authorised representative, employee, or contractor).
[EN] Multi-country presence, when the organisation operates in more than one country.
tier2Readiness.reviewNote: [EN] An owner or admin reviews each submission manually. Tier-2 status stays 'pilot' until that review completes; activation happens only after the human review records a decision.
tier2Readiness.notWritingNote: [EN] This page is a preview. It does not submit anything to the Tier-2 schema. It does not collect a card. It does not start billing.
